acceptanceCriteria: Every pinned source path is classified with an evidence-backed Rust or documentation counterpart and no deferred record remains in this batch.
Protocol semantics and participant-evidence/privacy boundary are documented consistently in English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese.
Historical source responses/results are not copied or presented as target participant evidence; no comprehension result is invented.
Reference inventory, comparison ledger, parity matrix, and three Work Item language files remain internally consistent and pass their executable checks.
Installed Runtime lifecycle produces verification, archive, reviewed PR, merge, close, promotion, and exact branch/worktree cleanup evidence.
goal: 为 12 个 comprehension-validation 源路径建立可审计的分类、Rust/文档对应物和不可移植边界，不捏造本工程读者研究结果。
intent: 逐文件比对 pinned reference comprehension-validation protocol、response schema、匿名回答与 results，明确哪些读者理解验证语义可由 Rust 工程继承，哪些参与者证据只能保留为 reference-only。
outOfScope: source Python/Make/V1 implementation and copying source response bytes
